extra.imageProcessing: Authorized-retailer official top-down empty board (Andertons 80184, 1056x594) on white. Components key removes the outer white background and enclosed open slots while preserving the classic logo; trim/resize to 800x444/350x194, AVIF q90. Aspect 1.802 vs 1.920 (6.2% pass), rotation 0.06°, perspective 6.5% (flag; reviewer accepted the flat geometry), PSNR 49.4 dB; 26.6 KB / 8.3 KB. Clean crisp alpha, transparent slots, no white fringe at 3x; reviewer approved. Pedalplayground is not used.
